spatialReadability.status: user-adopted for handled wire entry and turning volume
spatialReadability.criterion: Dense CAD-derived wire must visibly turn in three dimensions: curvature, depth and changing orientation must remain readable while the wire is clearly visible.
spatialReadability.reject: A front-facing spreadsheet-like grid, even if line counts and subsequent solid rotation pass technical checks.
review: Watch the wire-dominant interval as motion, not only still frames or the later clay/glaze rotation.
Confirm ring curvature/foreshortening and near/far relationships change visibly during the turn on desktop and mobile.
Keep CAD geometry accurate; tune wire visibility, motion overlap, view and depth cues instead of distorting the vessel to manufacture curvature.
The first independent wire view must already show elliptical rings/depth after the exact CAD alignment handoff; later rotation alone does not satisfy the entry view.
spatialReadability.verification: Density and numeric axis checks alone do not establish this visual criterion. Review the moving result against the selected moon reference before claiming adoption.
spatialReadability.feedback: 2026-10-17: user described current mug wire as an Excel grid and requested an impression of volumetric rolling.
